title: involucrella coronaria
intro: Involucrella coronaria, commonly known as the Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and the southwestern United States. This plant is valued for its bright yellow and orange flowers, as well as its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Involucrella coronaria, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. Additionally, the plant's flavonoids and phenolic acids may also exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
